heading: Definitions
lead: For the purposes of this subchapter—

tree.text: the term “preservation district” means the Jimmy Carter National Preservation District established under section 410hhhh–1 of this title;
the term “historical park” means the Jimmy Carter National Historical Park established under section 410hhhh of this title; and
the term “Secretary” means the Secretary of the Interior.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2021—Par. (2). Pub. L. 116–341, § 2(b)(4), (5), made identical amendments, substituting “historical park” for “historic site”. See Codification note set out under section 410hhhh of this title. Pub. L. 116–341, § 2(b)(3), substituted “National Historical Park” for “National Historic Site”. See Codification note set out under section 410hhhh of this title.
